scenes.say: Ever wonder how to prove your system is fast enough? Let’s talk about setting real performance testing goals.

scenes.label: Throughput
scenes.sub: Requests handled per second, like 5000 reqs
scenes.say: Throughput is all about how many requests your system can handle each second. For example, five thousand requests per second.
I always set measurable goals before running tests. For latency, I look at the slowest five percent of requests. And I make sure the error rate stays low.

scenes.question: Which metric matters most?
scenes.right: Percentiles like p95 show real user impact
scenes.say: Here’s a common trap: focusing only on average latency. But percentiles like p95 reveal what real users experience when things slow down.
